title: Prague 2011 earthquake-catalog construction (minimal instructions, expert tools, catalog checker and knowledge) - development window
summary: As the checker arm, plus the catalog-knowledge skill (pilot protocol, deciding between candidates, symptom playbook, errors no check sees) and the magnitude resource. Isolates the value of procedural knowledge over the whole pipeline (S3). Development loop: one day around the mainshock (2011-11-14T03:31:00Z to 2011-11-15T03:31:00Z).
